existing_id_check: Before assigning permanent IND ID, deduplicate with existing subsoil/water cards in master index
hidden_pattern: Licensing exists but actual daily extraction, approved test pumping schedule and verified measurement diverge; journal itself exposes violation
predictive_questions: Does each daily extraction amount stay within the exact licence cap including test pumping?
Is meter verification currently valid and recorded in the federal verification fund?
Do daily logs, approved test-pumping schedule and project documentation reconcile?
red_flags: Trial pumping used as justification outside approved project dates
Meter verification expired despite apparent readings
Journal not daily and has missing dates
commercial_application: Audit of groundwater licence compliance, well metering and monitoring; site service card
expert_targets: ROP_EXPERT only where connected to recycling operations and water intake
activation: RESEARCH_ONLY until tested diagnostic rule; no new radar, no modification of working worker
